name: NEON FRONTLINE · STYLIZED SCI-FI
summary: Black sky, teal horizon band, huge haloed Earth. Charcoal cratered regolith with lichen spores and Refuge hex grids. Hexagonal neon prefab pods, ringed oxygen towers. Glowing crystal and fungus growths replace trees. Magenta-veined Parasite hives and plasma batteries. Holographic contour map with leader-line labels.
